title: Approval desk
idea: Approval desk: Request rationale and before-after effect precede approval
audience: People who need to approve within a dashboard surface.
worksWellWhen: Privileged operations need a clear decision
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic decision layout through its approve priority and explicit commitment contract: Atomic authorization and audit precede executed changes
navigation: Approval desk keeps the current approve context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Request rationale and before-after effect precede approval
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to approve; privileged operations need a clear decision
composition.priority: Atomic authorization and audit precede executed changes

imagery.role: Support the actual approve context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Show full effect before the confirm control
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the approval desk structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no approve content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Atomic authorization and audit precede executed changes
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized approve content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Atomic authorization and audit precede executed changes
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active approve context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
